publications.commentary:
Most orchestration failures are not model failures. They are handoff failures: the step that ran twice, the approval nobody recorded, the output that went somewhere nobody checked.

We build the boring part — the ledger that says what happened, once.

More: https://stromy.com.au
A short note on why we stopped trying to promise exactly-once delivery to an external API, and started promising something we can actually keep: no automatic replay after an ambiguous send.
